assessments.assessment_basis: A peer-reviewed SAT 2023 theorem independently establishes classes where non-incremental bottom-up compilation has polynomial-size intermediates while every clause-at-a-time incremental core becomes exponential for relevant knowledge-compilation languages including OBDD.

assessments.scope_limits: Existential worst-case result only; it does not quantify frequency on the current generated streams or prove a specific online switch heuristic.
